title: Aromantic Logo
description: Adds a Aromantic colored logo as the Main Title!
body:
# Aromantic Logo

**Aromantic Logo is one of eight resource packs to change the main Minecraft Logo to be Pride featured.**
Aromantic logo changes the main Minecraft logo to be a simplistic, sharp, clean logo striped with the colors of the Aromantic flag. **Should work for any version, but 1.21.4 and 1.21.5 are the only confirmed ones. I don't see why any other version wouldn't work.**
